functions.label: AFT Grey Water Pump control & monitoring
functions.what_it_does: Runs the AFT grey water discharge pump on command from an ON/OFF/AUTO selector (S17) via a PC CARD controller, with run-indication and alarm status reported to the monitoring loom, and level sensed via a resistive sender.
functions.sheet_region: left/center of sheet, DC MAIN PANEL Q1 breaker row and S17 selector block, right-side AFT GREY WATER pump and sender

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q1 10A -> unlabeled contact pair -> T/S C terminal 76 (fused terminal) -> PC CARD controller -> AFT GREY WATER pump; pump run status looped back via T/S C 77 (fused) to RUN IND. lamp

PC CARD auto-runs pump based on AFT GREY WATER SENDER level input (variable resistor sender fed via SWB02/AFT connector XA70 pins 07(+)/08(-)); ALARM lamp/tap driven via T/S C terminal 80/81 to XA61 pin 08/12 monitoring loom on high level or fault
S17 selector (measured NO contact) manually forces pump ON or OFF, overriding AUTO logic; state reported via RUN IND./ALARM taps to XA61 monitoring pins 10/12

key_components: S17 ON/OFF/AUTO selector switch (NO contact, measured)
AFT GREY WATER SENDER (resistive level sender)
T/S C fused terminals 76/77/80/81 (fused-terminal troubleshooting points)
RUN IND. and ALARM status lamps

functions.label: FWD Grey Water Pump control & monitoring
functions.what_it_does: Runs the FWD grey water discharge pump via S18 ON/OFF/AUTO selector, with a FWD GREY WATER SENDER for level, run/alarm status fed to monitoring loom via terminals 97-101.
functions.sheet_region: lower-center of sheet, S18 selector block and Q6-area terminal group 97-101, FWD GREY WATER SENDER lower right

flow_scenarios.path: supply (not shown on this sheet) -> PC CARD terminal 97 (RUN tap 1, XA61-04) -> pump run indication; FWD GREY WATER SENDER level -> SWB01/FWD connector XA30 pins 01(+)/02(-) -> gauge circuit off-sheet
S18 AUTO position (measured NO contact) allows PC CARD to auto-command pump from sender level; ALARM tap 4/terminal 101 (XA61-02) reports to monitoring loom
S18 ON position feeds terminal 97 (RUN IND. lamp), OFF position ties to terminal 98 (XA61-06 tap 2)

key_components: FWD GREY WATER SENDER (resistive level sender)

equipment_groups.equipment_name: 530-sump-pumps (Port/Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sumps, Fwd/Aft Crew Head Sumps, Aft A/C Sump)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Engineer mapping ties PORT AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, FWD/AFT CREW SUMP PUMP, AFT AIRCON SUMP PUMP all to 530-sump-pumps; each is a distinct row/loop on this sheet fed from its own breaker (Q2-Q6) with local switch/fuse/pump and status looped to the PC CARD monitoring terminals.

functions.label: Port Aft Guest Grey Sump Pump
functions.what_it_does: Empties the Port Aft Guest cabin grey-water sump; local switch (measured NO) engages the pump directly, run status reported to monitoring loom via fused terminal 83.
functions.sheet_region: upper-left breaker row Q2 20A, upper-right pump/switch/fuse block

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q2 20A breaker -> terminal 82 -> local switch -> PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP PUMP -> discharge; a 1A fuse sits inline before/bypassing the switch as a protective/bypass leg
pump run reported via fused terminal 83 to RUN IND. lamp

functions.label: Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sump Pump
functions.what_it_does: Empties the Starboard Aft Guest cabin grey-water sump; same architecture as Port Aft Guest sump — local switch, 1A fuse, run status to monitoring loom via fused terminal 85.
functions.sheet_region: breaker row Q3 20A, pump/switch/fuse block right side

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q3 20A breaker -> terminal 84 -> local switch -> STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP PUMP -> discharge, with 1A inline fuse
pump run reported via fused terminal 85 to RUN IND. lamp

functions.label: Fwd Crew Head Grey Sump Pump
functions.what_it_does: Empties the Fwd crew head grey-water sump; activated via relay Re13 from breaker Q4, with a manual BY-PASS reed sump switch that can locally override/bypass the level-sensed reed switch to force pump run.
functions.sheet_region: breaker row Q4 10A / Re13 relay, pump + BY-PASS reed switch block right side

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q4 10A -> Re13 relay contact (measured NO) -> terminal 86 -> FWD CREW HEAD GREY SUMP PUMP, run status via terminal 88
operator closes the BY-PASS push-switch beside the REED SUMP SW., shorting across the reed switch to force the pump on regardless of sensed sump level

functions.label: Aft Crew Head Grey Sump Pump
functions.what_it_does: Empties the Aft crew head grey-water sump; activated via relay Re14 from breaker Q5, with the same manual BY-PASS reed sump switch arrangement as the Fwd unit.
functions.sheet_region: breaker row Q5 10A / Re14 relay, pump + BY-PASS reed switch block right side

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q5 10A -> Re14 relay contact (measured NO) -> terminal 89 -> AFT CREW HEAD GREY SUMP PUMP, run status via terminal 91
operator closes the BY-PASS pushbutton beside the REED SUMP SW., forcing the pump on independent of sensed sump level

functions.label: Aft A/C Sump Pump
functions.what_it_does: Empties the Aft air-conditioning condensate sump via breaker Q6, local switch and 1A inline fuse; run/alarm status reported to the monitoring loom (tap 1, terminal 97).
functions.sheet_region: breaker row Q6 20A / terminal group 97-101, AFT A/C SUMP PUMP block right side

flow_scenarios.path: DC MAIN PANEL Q6 20A breaker -> terminal 97 (tap 1) -> local switch -> 1A inline fuse -> AFT A/C SUMP PUMP -> discharge
run indication at terminal 97 (XA61-04); alarm on terminal 101 (tap 4, XA61-02) to PC CARD monitoring loom

equipment_groups.equipment_name: 652-onyx-monitoring (monitoring loom taps consolidated on this sheet)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: A dedicated numbered tap block (pins 5,6,8,9 -> terminals 92-96) consolidates status signals from MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, AFT A/C SUMP, and BACKUP EM POWER (GMDSS BACKUP) into a single monitoring loom via the PC CARD/XA61 connector — this is the ONYX monitoring interface, not a function of any one pump equipment.

functions.label: Consolidated status taps to ONYX monitoring
functions.what_it_does: Collects individual bilge/sump/grey-water status signals from other equipment (most not detailed on this sheet — only labelled by name) into terminals 92-96 for onward reporting via the XA61 connector to the ONYX monitoring system.
functions.sheet_region: left-center block below Re13/Re14, terminal rows 92-96 with pin labels 5/6/8/9

flow_scenarios.path: MAST BILGE / ENGINE ROOM BILGE / OWNERS GREY SUMP / FWD GUEST GREY SUMP / AFT A/C SUMP / BACKUP EM POWER (GMDSS BACKUP) status signals -> terminals 92-96 -> XA61 connector -> ONYX monitoring (off-sheet)

infrastructure.system_name: DC MAIN PANEL / MAIN PANEL breaker distribution (this sheet)
facts: Breakers Q1(10A)-Q6(20A) on DC MAIN PANEL/MAIN PANEL feed the individual pump circuits detailed above; bus/panel structure itself is shared infrastructure, not equipment.
T/S B, T/S C, T/S E terminal strips and PC CARD controller module form the local terminal/relay infrastructure of this AFT SERVICE PUMPS panel section.
Multi-core cable MU4-12 links this sheet's terminal strip to T/S F on DWG-120 (12-wire, see cross-reference).

good_to_have: Exact fuse ratings for T/S C terminals 76/77/80/81/83/85/92-96 — shown as fused-terminal symbols, values not called out; capture at inspection if needed.
1A inline fuses at each sump/AC pump — value legible (1A) but part number not given.
Q1-Q6 breaker part numbers/manufacturer not given, only amperage ratings which are legible on the sheet.
composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-115, 'AFT SERVICE PUMPS') serves the vessel's Grey Water Pump system (530-grey-water-pumps: AFT and FWD grey water discharge pumps) and Sump Pump system (530-sump-pumps: Port/Stbd Aft Guest grey sumps, Fwd/Aft Crew Head sumps, Aft A/C sump) — evidenced by the load names printed directly above each breaker (AFT GREY WATER P., PORT/STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, FWD/AFT CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP, AFT A/C SUMP PUMP) matching the engineer-confirmed vocabulary mapping. A secondary block of consolidated status taps (terminals 92-96, XA61 connector) serves the ONYX monitoring system (652-onyx-monitoring) by collecting bilge/sump/grey-water status signals for off-sheet reporting.
uncertainties: ALARM relay contact (coil XA61) is flagged as a symbol/wiring CONFLICT in the netlist — symbol reads NC but wiring measures NO; the true fail-safe alarm behavior (alarm-on-loss-of-power vs alarm-on-signal) needs engineer confirmation.
Relay contact 90 (coil) is flagged CONFLICT — symbol read as NO but wiring shows NC; affects whether the Aft Crew Head sump pump run/status line is normally made or normally broken.
Positive/feed side of EMERGENCY BAT +24V circuit (via T/S E terminal 8) is not traced on this sheet — only the terminal and downstream line are shown; source panel is off-sheet.

MAST BILGE / ENGINE ROOM BILGE / OWNERS GREY SUMP / FWD GUEST GREY SUMP status taps (terminals 92-96) name equipment not otherwise detailed on this sheet — their pump hardware (breakers, switches) is not shown here; only the monitoring tap exists on this sheet, the equipment itself is presumably detailed elsewhere.

Correspondence between S18's ON/OFF/AUTO positions and terminals 97/98/99 is per the printed layout order only — not explicitly confirmed by a separate netlist entry; treat with caution pending confirmation.
